reader: source-only reader (publisher pictures + page text as sealed in the source package); no analyzer, solver or model output was run or seen for this house
sideConvention: FRONT = the side at the BOTTOM of the ground-floor plan sheet as published; LEFT/RIGHT = the plan sheet's left/right; REAR = top of the sheet
alongShareBasis: alongShare = [from,to] as shares 0..1 of the FULL outer-wall extent of the building on that side (attached garage wing included; open porches, terraces and roof overhangs excluded), measured left to right AS SEEN FROM OUTSIDE looking at that side; read by eye from the elevation picture and cross-checked against the plan where possible; expect +/-0.04

overallWidthM.where: single overall line above the plan

overallDepthM.where: outer line right of the plan; inner chain 165 + 938 + 165

metricCertain.whatTheOverallIncludes: width 1368 = outer walls, left to right (the side stoop 1.11 on the right is outside). depth 1268 = 165 (rear open porch 1.12, to its posts) + 938 (the walls, rear to front) + 165 (front open entrance porch 1.10, to its posts): the overall depth INCLUDES BOTH OPEN PORCHES; the walls-only depth is 938.
